description: 快速验证集（10 用例，从 eval_v1 按情景类型代表性抽样：时间粒度/三维度/排行/TopN/组合/派生指标/空结果/default 兜底与数字词干扰例）。用于日常开发回归（约 3 分钟），正式实验仍用 eval_v1。

cases.query: 华北地区2025年第一季度的GMV是多少
cases.golden_sql: SELECT SUM(fo.order_amount) AS gmv FROM fact_order fo JOIN dim_region dr ON fo.region_id = dr.region_id JOIN dim_date dd ON fo.date_id = dd.date_id WHERE dr.region_name = '华北' AND dd.year = 2025 AND dd.quarter = 'Q1'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT fo.order_id) AS total_orders FROM fact_order fo JOIN dim_date dd ON fo.date_id = dd.date_id WHERE dd.year = 2025
SELECT SUM(fo.order_amount) AS sales FROM fact_order fo JOIN dim_date dd ON fo.date_id = dd.date_id WHERE dd.year = 2025 AND dd.month = 3

cases.query: 广东省的订单总数是多少
cases.golden_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT fo.order_id) AS orders FROM fact_order fo JOIN dim_region dr ON fo.region_id = dr.region_id WHERE dr.province = '广东省'

cases.query: 黄金会员2025年的总消费金额是多少
cases.golden_sql: SELECT SUM(fo.order_amount) AS spend FROM fact_order fo JOIN dim_customer dc ON fo.customer_id = dc.customer_id WHERE dc.member_level = '黄金'
SELECT dp.category AS category, SUM(fo.order_quantity) AS quantity FROM fact_order fo JOIN dim_product dp ON fo.product_id = dp.product_id GROUP BY dp.category ORDER BY quantity DESC

cases.query: 销售额排名前5的品牌有哪些
cases.golden_sql: SELECT dp.brand AS brand, SUM(fo.order_amount) AS sales FROM fact_order fo JOIN dim_product dp ON fo.product_id = dp.product_id GROUP BY dp.brand ORDER BY sales DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT dr.region_name AS region_name, SUM(fo.order_amount) AS gmv FROM fact_order fo JOIN dim_region dr ON fo.region_id = dr.region_id GROUP BY dr.region_name ORDER BY gmv DESC LIMIT 1
cases.notes: BUG-2026-09-30-01 回归哨兵：大区 GROUP BY 粒度

cases.query: 字节跳动品牌2025年的销售额
cases.golden_sql: SELECT SUM(fo.order_amount) AS sales FROM fact_order fo JOIN dim_product dp ON fo.product_id = dp.product_id WHERE dp.brand = '字节跳动'
